full_pair.limitations: Internal burst-view agreement, no independent displacement truth. Same geometry, grid, ownership, chip/search, zero prior and quality thresholds. No smoothing or gap filling.

overlap_controls.selection: Both unspliced_magnitude burst views peak >= 0.5, agree within 1/16 azimuth and 1/8 range pixel; seam-crossing fixed owner in that pair; all variants quality-valid

complex_overlap_controls.selection: Both unspliced_complex burst views peak >= 0.5, agree within 1/16 azimuth and 1/8 range pixel; seam-crossing fixed owner in that pair; all variants quality-valid

shared_overlap_controls.interpretation: Same centers selected by agreeing independent burst views under BOTH preprocessing modes. Neither consensus is independent displacement truth.

known_range_shift_controls.scope: Known range translations of real complex SLC textures with zero azimuth shift; no temporal decorrelation, independent glacier truth or smoothing.

recommendation: Unspliced deramp=1 matching is an experimental candidate that reduces along-track splice artifacts but retains cross-swath differences; do not treat as a validated production fix. Compare ISCE2-equivalent common validity, last-source merging and actual CPU magnitude matching before algorithm adoption.
scope: Isolated CPU experiment only; no production algorithm/default or products changed.
exploratory_azimuth_control_limit: An initial mixed-azimuth/range Fourier-shift trial did not recover imposed azimuth translations reliably under either preprocessing mode. It is retained in seam_investigation/march2017/known-shifts/report.json, excluded from method selection, and does not validate absolute azimuth accuracy. Subsequent range-only controls isolate range interpolation.
